vitality.death_checks.title: Vitality & Death Checks
vitality.death_checks.summary: When Wounds (Wnd) >= Vitality (Vit), you fall unconscious. If Wounds > Vitality, you must make a Death Check each round: Moxie roll vs DC = 5 + (Wounds - Vit). Failure results in death.

vitality.healing.title: Rest & Natural Healing
vitality.healing.summary: Post-combat rest (max 1/encounter) restores 1d4 Vit. A full Day rest (sleep/new day) restores 2d4 Vit and resets all daily abilities.

leveling.creation_steps.title: Character Creation Steps
leveling.creation_steps.summary: 1. Traits & Concept. 2. Attributes: Assign 2x d4, 2x d6, 1x d8 across Might, Motion, Mind, Magic, Moxie. 3. Starting Vit: 10 + 1d(Moxie). 4. Starting Focus Die: d4. 5. Select 2 Skilled sets and 1 Power.

leveling.advancement_steps.title: Leveling & AP Advancement
leveling.advancement_steps.summary: At each Level up, gain AP to spend across 3 Tiers: Tier 1 (Utility/Traits 1-2 AP), Tier 2 (Atr/Focus Die upgrades 2-8 AP), Tier 3 (Heroic Capstones 5-8 AP). Vit increases by rolling Vit Max.

skills.basics.title: Skilled vs. Unskilled Rolls
skills.basics.summary: ANY character can attempt ANY skill roll. Unskilled rolls use 1d20 + Atr Die. Skilled rolls (learned with AP) use 2H20 (keep highest of 2d20) + Atr Die.

col.weapons.dmg.title: Damage (💥)
col.weapons.dmg.summary: Total damage dealt on a successful attack hit. Calculated as Weapon Dice + Attribute Die.

col.weapons.range.title: Range (🎯)
col.weapons.range.summary: Maximum effective distance for weapon attacks: Touch, Melee, Short (up to 30ft), Long (up to 120ft).

col.weapons.atr.title: Attribute (✅)
col.weapons.atr.summary: The Attribute governing rolls with this weapon: Might for melee/heavy, Motion for ranged/finesse.

col.armor.ar.title: Armor Rating (🧥)
col.armor.ar.summary: Damage reduction die rolled when hit by an attack. Reduces incoming Wounds by the AR roll result.

col.shields.block.title: Block Rating (🛡️)
col.shields.block.summary: Defense bonus or active Block die rolled to negate incoming physical attacks.

col.powers.usage.title: Usage Frequency (🔄)
col.powers.usage.summary: How often the Power can be activated: At-Will, 1-Round, 1-Encounter, or 1-Day.

col.powers.action.title: Action Cost (🔷)
col.powers.action.summary: Action budget required to activate: Action (A), Move (M), Power (P), or Free (F).

col.powers.duration.title: Duration (⏳)
col.powers.duration.summary: How long the effect lasts: Instant, 1-Round, Encounter, or Sustained.

col.powers.range.title: Range (🎯)
col.powers.range.summary: Targeting distance: Self, Touch, Short, Long, or Zone.

col.powers.ap.title: AP Cost (🧩)
col.powers.ap.summary: Advancement Points required to unlock and learn this Power.

col.magic_items.category.title: Item Category (💫)
col.magic_items.category.summary: Item tier and type: Minor, Lesser, Greater, or Relic.
